unsupported_fields.lesion_area_mm2: Unavailable because physical pixel spacing is not verified for the locked MedSeg image.
unsupported_fields.lesion_volume_mm3: Unavailable because the input is a selected 2D image, not a verified complete CT volume.
unsupported_fields.lesion_volume_cm3: Unavailable because complete-volume voxel geometry is not available.
unsupported_fields.whole_lung_involvement_percent: Unavailable because a deployable lung-mask denominator is not available in the core evaluation.
unsupported_fields.patient_level_burden: Unavailable because verified MedSeg patient grouping is not available.
unsupported_fields.laterality: Unavailable because verified orientation and lung separation required for laterality are not established.
unsupported_fields.lobar_location: Unavailable because lobar anatomy is not inferred from a 2D image midpoint.

limitations: Evidence is derived from a selected 2D MedSeg image and must not be interpreted as a complete-volume measurement.
Physical lesion area and volume are unavailable because verified physical geometry is not established.
Whole-lung involvement is unavailable because a deployable lung denominator is not available.
Laterality and lobar localization are not emitted.
An empty predicted lesion mask means only that no target opacity was detected by the model; it does not establish a normal scan or absence of disease.
